answer_1.quote: Personalized dialogue generation ... prompts an agent to generate consistent responses based on historical dialogue context and given persona profiles ... In this work, we choose story data to facilitate the generation of more engaging and contextually meaningful dialogues.

answer_2.quote: The evaluation comprises three metrics. The first metric is F1... The second metric is BLEU... The third metric is ROUGE-L... The evaluation metrics for LAPDOG have been broadened to incorporate METEOR and BERT scores.

answer_4.quote: We conducted a human evaluation to gauge the preference between the retrieval-augmented LAP-DOG and the fine-tuned T5 model. Evaluators were presented with a dialogue accompanied by two responses from each model and were asked to choose their preferred response.
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators were asked to select the preferred response between two system outputs for each dialogue.
